summary: End-to-end testing of ChaosKey+ M3 mobile PWA. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering identity, pubkey, status, get_random (system + camera + fallback + validation), ledger chain integrity, and universe simulation. Frontend: all 4 tabs (Harvest, Ledger, Universe, Device) rendered and functional on 420x900 mobile viewport. System-entropy harvest creates blocks, ledger fetches & renders blocks, universe sim returns trajectory + SVG chart, device tab shows QR + PEM. No critical issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~520 lines — acceptable but if growth continues, consider splitting into modules (crypto, ledger, universe, api).
load_last_block() does not project signature_hex consistently — currently OK since it returns full doc minus _id, but be aware.
Chain integrity check in /api/status only samples last 6 blocks; full chain verification would be expensive but currently relies on sample. Consider documenting this.
frame_diffs_b64 is decoded with except Exception silently — invalid b64 entries are skipped without telemetry; consider counting bad frames in response.
Universe sim does N+births sequential awaits on generate_block — fine for small steps but may be slow for steps=80, initial_pop=30. Consider batching.
All endpoints proper Pydantic validation; data-testids consistent; CORS configured; env vars not hardcoded — good practices observed.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several ledger blocks via /api/get_random and /api/simulate_universe during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ChaosKey+ M3 is a mobile-first PWA wrapping a cryptographic entropy device. Backend has 6 endpoints under /api. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_chaoskey.py covers all of them with chain-integrity assertions. Camera testing on real device requires getUserMedia which is unavailable in headless — frontend camera path was not exercised; use system-entropy-btn for harvest in UI tests. Universe sim can take ~5-15s depending on size; allow >30s wait for large sims. All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes. Backend URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
